## 中文
`v3.5.3` 是一次 macOS 拖拽体验修复更新。
### 主要改动
- 修复首次拖拽文件时必须紧贴状态栏图标才能触发 DropZone 的问题。 - 拖拽靠近状态栏区域时会先显示候选 DropZone，再由系统拖放回调校验真实文件。 - 新增拖拽触发自测，并接入 CI。
### 发布资产
- `AirSend-v3.5.3-macOS.zip` - `AirSend_Magisk_v3.5.1.zip`（Android/Magisk 资产沿用上一版最新版）
## English
`v3.5.3` is a macOS drag-and-drop usability fix.
### Highlights
- Fixed the first-drag case where DropZone only appeared when the pointer touched the status-bar icon. - Shows a candidate DropZone near the status-bar area first, then lets the system drop callback validate real files. - Added drag handoff self-tests and wired them into CI.
### Release Assets
- `AirSend-v3.5.3-macOS.zip` - `AirSend_Magisk_v3.5.1.zip` (latest unchanged Android/Magisk asset)

## 中文
`v3.5.2` 是一次小型 macOS 稳定性更新，主要修复最近反馈的两个问题。
### 主要改动
- 修复状态栏菜单偶发打开后立即消失的问题。 - 优化 macOS 冷启动网络栈初始化，降低启动几秒后退出的风险。 - 加固证书生成时的网卡 IP 枚举，避免异常网卡地址影响启动。
### 发布资产
- `AirSend-v3.5.2-macOS.zip` - `AirSend_Magisk_v3.5.1.zip`（Android/Magisk 资产沿用上一版最新版）
## English
`v3.5.2` is a small macOS stability update for two recently reported issues.
### Highlights
- Fixed a status-bar menu issue where the menu could open and immediately disappear. - Simplified macOS cold-start networking initialization to reduce early-exit risk. - Hardened certificate IP enumeration so unusual network interfaces do not affect startup.
### Release Assets
- `AirSend-v3.5.2-macOS.zip` - `AirSend_Magisk_v3.5.1.zip` (latest unchanged Android/Magisk asset)

## 中文
`v3.5.1` 是一次稳定性与发布质量更新，重点补齐自动更新、传输进度、大文件内存安全和发布资产完整性。
这版不是单点功能堆叠，而是把 AirSend 作为长期可更新应用所需要的几条关键链路打通：Mac 端可以从状态栏发现新版本并通过 Sparkle 自动下载/安装；Mac 向 Android 发送大文件时会实时显示进度；Android 侧的守护进程和 App 同步线程也更稳。
### 主要改动
- macOS 接入 Sparkle 自动更新，保留状态栏里的 “Check for Update” 样式入口，新版本可点击下载并安装。 - Mac → Android 文件上传改回可控的 `URLSession` 路径，传输过程中会实时刷新进度，不再只在完成后更新。 - 修复 `SessionDelegate` 里重复触发进度回调的问题。 - Android Service 的 peers 同步任务现在只会保留一个轮询线程，避免重复启动服务后叠加后台线程。 - Android daemon 的直连文件发送与接收改为流式处理，降低大文件传输时的内存风险。 - 修复 Android `MagicWatcher` 在 minSdk 26 上触发的 `FileObserver` API 兼容问题。 - 新增 CI 门禁：macOS Swift build/app bundle、Rust daemon/patched LocalSend、Android lint/test/assemble。 - 新增发布资产完整性保护：每个 GitHub Release 都必须同时包含 macOS 应用和 `AirSend_Magisk*.zip`，即使只更新 Mac 端，也会重新附上 Android/Magisk 模块资产。 - macOS、Android APK、Magisk 模块版本号统一提升到 `3.5.1` / `351`。
### 发布资产
- `AirSend-v3.5.1-macOS.zip` - `AirSend_Magisk_v3.5.1.zip`
### 更新建议
- 推荐所有 Mac 用户更新，以获得自动更新能力和更可靠的大文件发送进度。 - 使用完整 Android 模式的用户建议同时刷新 Magisk 模块；这次模块包含 daemon 流式传输与 Android 兼容性修复。
## English
`v3.5.1` is a stability and release-quality update focused on automatic updates, transfer progress, large-file memory safety, and complete release assets.
This release ties together several foundations AirSend needs as a long-lived app: the Mac app can now surface updates from the menu bar and install them through Sparkle, Mac → Android large-file uploads report live progress, and the Android service/daemon paths are more resilient.
### Highlights
- Added Sparkle automatic updates on macOS while preserving the status-bar “Check for Update” entry; new versions can be downloaded and installed in-app. - Switched Mac → Android uploads back to a controllable `URLSession` path so transfer progress updates live instead of only after completion. - Removed a duplicate progress callback in `SessionDelegate`. - Guarded the Android Service peer sync loop so repeated service starts do not stack polling threads. - Changed Android daemon direct file send/receive paths to stream file bodies, reducing large-file memory risk. - Fixed the Android `MagicWatcher` `FileObserver` API compatibility issue for minSdk 26. - Added CI gates for macOS Swift/app bundle, Rust daemon/patched LocalSend, and Android lint/test/assemble. - Added a release asset completeness guard: every GitHub Release must include both the macOS app and `AirSend_Magisk*.zip`; even Mac-only updates re-attach the Android/Magisk module asset. - Aligned macOS, Android APK, and Magisk module versions to `3.5.1` / `351`.
### Release Assets
- `AirSend-v3.5.1-macOS.zip` - `AirSend_Magisk_v3.5.1.zip`
### Update Recommendation
- Mac users should update for automatic updates and more reliable large-file progress. - Full Android mode users should refresh the Magisk module as well; it includes daemon streaming and Android compatibility fixes.
